newsitem.title: UK: BA link-up faces tough U.S. curbs - paper.
newsitem.headline: BA link-up faces tough U.S. curbs - paper.

text.p: U.S. airlines are to insist on Washington imposing harsher conditions on the transatlantic alliance between British Airways (BA) and American Airlines than those proposed by British authorities, The Independent newspaper reported on Wednesday.

The world's largest carrier, United Airlines, is to urge U.S. regulators to block some of the most lucrative benefits of the tie-up while Delta Air Lines was confident the alliance would face curbs to gain approval for the deal in the U.S., the newspaper said.
The deadline for airlines to respond to the conditions imposed by Britain's Office of Fair trading which has advised BA and American shed 168 take-off and landing slots at Heathrow.
